prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create an ORIGINAL academic illustrated diagram in Brazilian Portuguese for medical students, inspired by the clarity of excellent epidemiology textbooks, NOT copying any existing illustration. Landscape 1800x1400 if possible, crisp white/ivory background, navy typography, thin precise lines, restrained muted teal and ochre. Three generous horizontal rows, legible large labels, editorial medical textbook quality. Header EXACT "Três desenhos, três portas de entrada". Row 1 title EXACT "COORTE": on LEFT two small clusters of abstract person icons labeled "Expostos" and "Não expostos"; a clear arrow pointing RIGHT labeled "Acompanhar desfechos"; RIGHT a neutral outcome document icon labeled "Desfecho". Row 2 EXACT "CASO-CONTROLE": RIGHT two groups of abstract people labeled "Casos" and "Controles"; a clear arrow pointing LEFT labeled "Investigar exposição anterior"; LEFT a document icon labeled "Exposição". Critical: cohort arrow points right; case-control arrow points left, not both directions. Row 3 EXACT "TRANSVERSAL": a framed snapshot with abstract person icons, a calendar icon, and labels "Exposição + desfecho" and "No mesmo recorte". No directional arrow in row 3. Bottom note EXACT "Coortes podem ser prospectivas ou retrospectivas." then "O transversal não estabelece, por si só, precedência temporal." Only the specified short labels, no numbers, no risk estimates, no invented patient data, no treatment, no logo or watermark. Reserve bottom right whitespace for an exact official logo inserted separately. Use distinct panels with ample white space, carefully proofread accents.

Use case: scientific-educational. ORIGINAL Portuguese academic illustrated explanatory plate for medical students about the ecological fallacy, no copying of any reference. Landscape 1800x1200, generous white/ivory background, navy headings, elegant flat editorial textbook illustrations with restrained teal and ochre. Header EXACT "Do grupo ao indivíduo: cuidado com a inferência". Two columns. Left heading EXACT "DADOS AGREGADOS": draw two distinct large soft outlined circular groups with abstract person glyphs inside, neutral small town skyline behind, label "Grupo A" and "Grupo B", and below "Associação entre grupos". Do not encode numeric proportions or fake charts. Center a thin visual divider and a small question mark, NOT a direct causal arrow. Right heading EXACT "DADOS INDIVIDUAIS": show a magnifying glass over a single person glyph and two neutral small evidence documents labeled "Exposição" and "Desfecho". Bottom large key statement EXACT "Uma associação entre grupos não autoriza concluir a mesma relação em cada pessoa." Supporting small line EXACT "Falácia ecológica: atribuir ao indivíduo uma relação observada no agregado." Avoid mathematical inequality signs, claims that group data are useless, individual-level causal assertions, numeric values, patient records, logos, watermarks. Leave bottom right clear margin for exact brand insert separately. Large legible Portuguese labels, correct accents.

Use case: scientific-educational. ORIGINAL conceptual medical illustration for students showing FIVE distinct mechanisms underlying the traditional five syndromic categories of acute abdomen. White/ivory editorial academic plate, navy labels, muted anatomical pink/red, restrained gold and teal. Landscape 1800x1300. Header EXACT "Cinco mecanismos do abdome agudo". Five illustrated panels arranged three above, two centered below. Each shows a simplified isolated schematic bowel loop/vessel, NOT complete human anatomy and not a real patient. Panel 1 EXACT "Inflamatório": swollen inflamed bowel wall subtly red. Panel 2 EXACT "Perfurativo": visibly broken bowel wall with tiny escaping gas bubbles into surrounding space. Panel 3 EXACT "Obstrutivo": a blocked intestinal lumen with clearly distended proximal segment and narrower distal segment, obstruction physically visible. Panel 4 EXACT "Vascular": arterial branch feeding bowel is visibly blocked by clot, bowel pale, no blood leakage; label below "Redução do fluxo sanguíneo". Panel 5 EXACT "Hemorrágico": a breached vessel with a small contained collection of blood OUTSIDE the vessel; label below "Sangramento". Do not confuse ischemia with hemorrhage. Respect conceptual anatomy. Small footer EXACT "Esquema conceitual dos mecanismos, sem escala anatômica." No treatment advice, diagnosis algorithm, percentages, doses, fictitious patient information, logos or watermark. Reserve bottom right white space for exact navy brand later. Clean academic hand-drawn digital vector-like linework, rich but restrained teaching illustration, not a marketing icon.

Use case: scientific-educational. ORIGINAL academic medical explanatory plate, in Portuguese, about FOUR PRIMARY acid-base disturbances. Landscape 1800x1400, white/ivory, navy serif headings and very legible sans-serif labels, refined muted teal for metabolic panels and muted ochre for respiratory panels, academic textbook clarity. Header EXACT "Quatro distúrbios primários ácido-base". Four large panels 2x2. Top left "Acidose metabólica": a small clean bicarbonate buffer/molecule illustration (do not draw invented chemistry bonds), labels EXACT "HCO₃⁻ ↓" and "Tendência do pH ↓". Top right "Alcalose metabólica": matching illustration, "HCO₃⁻ ↑" and "Tendência do pH ↑". Bottom left "Acidose respiratória": simple accurate paired lungs illustration, "PaCO₂ ↑" and "Tendência do pH ↓". Bottom right "Alcalose respiratória": paired lungs, "PaCO₂ ↓" and "Tendência do pH ↑". Make all eight arrows UNAMBIGUOUS and in exactly these directions. Label distinction primary variable and pH effect, no compensatory arrows or thresholds. Bottom explanatory line EXACT "Alteração primária e efeito sobre o pH em distúrbios simples." then EXACT "Compensação e distúrbios mistos exigem avaliação própria." No treatment, no doses, no numbers, no real lab data, no kidney as sole metabolic cause, no logo or watermark. Leave clean lower right area for exact navy official logo inserted afterward. High precision typography and symbols, plenty of breathing room.
